facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the tax department and CASS social security; steps not confirmed yet.
facts.L2_tax_id: NRT (Tax Register Number), used for all Andorran tax dealings.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Income tax is 0% up to €24,000, then 5%, and 10% above €40,000.
facts.L4_vat_gst: IGI (VAT) is 4.5%; all businesses trading in Andorra must register.
facts.L5_data_protection: A data protection law exists; details not confirmed yet.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
facts.D1_id_document: No national ID card; passports and driving licences are used.
